title: Smart Retail Inventory & Stock Forecasting System
subtitle: Web-based POS and Inventory Management System with Single Exponential Smoothing (SES) Demand Forecasting
category: Full Stack Web Development / Data Analytics
summary: An intelligent retail management web application that automates Point of Sale operations, inventory tracking, and stock demand forecasting using Single Exponential Smoothing (SES) with automated error evaluation metrics (MAD, MSE, MAPE).
keyFeatures: Interactive Analytics Dashboard with curved line area chart and product sales composition doughnut chart
Single Exponential Smoothing (SES) Engine with customizable alpha smoothing constant (0.1 to 0.9)
Step-by-step mathematical breakdown table for transparency in forecasting calculations
Automated stock status alert (Perlu Tambah Stok vs Stok Cukup) with exact reorder recommendation quantity
Multi-item POS transaction checkout with automated stock deduction
Print-ready official reports for Master Items, Sales Transactions, Top Selling Items, and SES Stock Predictions
High-performance PHP Seeder script for generating 500 realistic sales transactions across 70+ days

architecture.includes: Mathematics calculation engine and SES forecasting functions
architecture.laporan: Printable report modules with official letterhead
architecture.proses: Backend action handlers and batch data generator scripts
